title: Ole Miss @ Oklahoma: the game the ground stop pushed to Sunday
sub: Sunday 1:00 PM ET · Norman, OK · OU -2.5 · total 49.5 (DraftKings)
body: Friday's nationwide FAA ground stop kept Ole Miss from leaving Oxford, and the SEC moved the game to Sunday over the school's objection. The new kickoff lands on a soaking day in Norman: about 10 mm of rain through the morning and showers during the game, mid-40s.
fact: It was the first nationwide FAA ground stop since January 2023. Nine games on this slate moved. This total has already fallen from 53.5 at the open to 49.5, and Pinnacle has the under juiced to -116.
model: Model take: fair total 50.4 (it likes the over), while the steady-rain system says under. They cancel out, and both sides are priced worse than Pinnacle: no play. Under 49.5 only at -111 or better.
